newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE nearby canola ends down on March liquidation.
newsitem.headline: WCE nearby canola ends down on March liquidation.

text.p: WCE nearby canola futures closed lower on liquidation in the March contract and active spreading, traders said.

"Liquidation of the March kept the May heavy. The board crush profit margin got a lot better today. C$9 a bushel for canola across Saskatchewan brought in hedges," a trader said. March canola futures crush margin rose to -13.65 Friday from -22.31 Thursday. About 1,000 Mar-May spread at $2 and 1,000 May-Nov $44. Volume was 7,850 lots with 325 hedges.
Japan bought 4,000-5,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
March canola fell $4.30 to $409.70 and May closed down $0.80 to $413.70. March flax ended down $2 to $351. Mar-May spread $2.

March western barley lost $0.30 to $141.20, May up $0.20 to $142.40 with Midland Walwyn covering shorts, traders said. Louis Dreyfus bought October and December, sources also said. Mar-July spread at $0.50, Mar-May spread $0.50. Volume was 2,400 lots.

March feed wheat rose $1.30 to $175.20 and May lost $0.70 to $168.50 by the close, with PCTS selling and Cargill buying, traders noted. LFG sold May and July, traders said. March-May spread at $5.50. Volume was 1,100 lots.
Oats and feed peas did not trade.
(Values in Canadian dollars/tonne except oats and peas.)
